title: Zwischenbericht Cover Page Layout
description: zwischenbericht cover layout: split cover title into row of two windows for Zukunft Bau and Titel, add subtitle row
summary: Fixed zwischenbericht compile hang. Root cause was tier_header storing unexpanded \tl_use:N \l_semio_window_number_tl into the same tl (infinite recursion in header_muted_use), plus expl3/LaTeX2e boundary bugs in register_write (\alph{semio@window@slot}) and kind number capture (\semio@window@kind@number via edef). Fixes: removed redundant tier_header calls; added semio_window_kind_number_set:n in pure expl3; fixed register_write to use int_to_alph:n/int_use:c. Full zwischenbericht light+dark PDFs now build in ~30s.
